task_title: Tier-1 gate cannot complete on a loaded box: tests(full) timeout without named test; 409 foreign sync-lock teardown; leftover namespace census
task_criteria: Gate pytest arm finishes or reports a bounded attributable result with first-failing test named under load; foreign-pid 409 teardown classified as environment contention and not reding the gate; leftovers reported

items.criterion: Gate pytest arm finishes or reports a bounded attributable result with first-failing test named under load; foreign-pid 409 teardown classified as environment contention and not reding the gate; leftovers reported
items.detail: All three legs verified with live probes. (1) Timeout attribution: tests/gate.sh:40-46 exports AUGER_GATE_PROGRESS_FILE; gate.sh:371-381 on rc 124/137 runs scripts/gate_timeout_report.py then exit 1; conftest.py:688-706 logstart/logreport hooks append JSONL. Live probe `AUGER_GATE_PYTEST_BUDGET=20s bash tests/gate.sh` (exit_code 0 shell, GATE_RC=1 gate) printed 'first failing test (in flight when the arm was killed): tests/test_auger.py::test_answer_refuses_invalid_confidence_without_storing_rows[above-one]' + 'progress records: 98 lines, 25 test starts' — bounded, attributable, fail-closed. (2) Foreign-409: conftest.py:264-271 classify_push_conflict() keys on the body's 'held by pid N' (SYNC_LOCK_PID_RE); teardown_namespace conftest.py:429-455 fails fast (no 61s ladder) appending ENV-CONTENTION message naming the pid with row+directory kept; ns_created finalizer conftest.py:903-917 passes the test on contention-only problems; tests/test_auger.py:71-90 assert_clean_teardown, :6383-6400 postcondition test skips naming the pid, :6405-6445 leak audit attributes foreign-409 residue with one DELETE; hermetic proof test_foreign_pid_409_fails_fast_without_burning_the_ladder passed (1 DELETE, zero sleeps, pid named, dir kept). The prior-stage red (tests/test_spec_ingest.py[code-factory]) is pre-existing host corpus drift: ~/code-factory/specs/ENVELOPE.md mtime Nov 21 20:37 vs corpora/code-factory manifest last commit Nov 16 (237fa7f); the diff touches neither corpora/ nor test_spec_ingest.py, so it does not block this task's criterion. (3) Leftovers: scripts/auger_ns_census.py live run output 'leftover test namespaces in the REGISTRY: 1 ... - auger-pytest-ce77a6a5-5c7e69ba98c3' rc=0; the reaper census write_reap_report (conftest.py:564-590) prints reaped/deferred/ghosts via terminal reporter + stderr; reap_prior_session_namespaces (conftest.py:494-537) runs inside the substrate lock at live_service setup (conftest.py:862-875).

items.criterion: The timeout attribution branch in gate.sh is reachable from the guard's test command and still fails closed
items.detail: guards.test_command is 'bash tests/gate.sh' (.gitreins/config.yaml:15); live probe of that script with a 20s budget produced the attribution block and GATE_RC=1; tests/test_substrate_hygiene.py:455-470 test_gate_wires_the_progress_file_and_the_attribution_report pins the 124/137 branch, the report invocation, and the loud 'attribution UNAVAILABLE' path.

items.criterion: The foreign-409 contention path does not weaken leak detection (mixed problems still fail; reaper never touches non-test or current-session namespaces)
items.detail: tests/test_substrate_hygiene.py: test_contention_only_predicate_is_not_loose (mixed contention+500 -> False), test_reaper_reaps_prior_sessions_and_spares_the_current_one (current tag + 'hermes-memory' spared), test_reaper_removes_ghost_directories_but_only_test_prefixed; ns_created finalizer only returns on ALL-contention problems (conftest.py:903) and pytest.fail still fires for any other residue (conftest.py:938).

items.criterion: The contention 'return inside finally' cannot mask a genuine test failure
items.detail: Empirical probe: a fixture with try/yield/finally:return plus a test body `assert False` still reports '1 failed' (exit shows FAILED fin_probe/test_probe.py::test_failing_via_fixture); the gate's plain-failure path is unchanged (`run_pytest_arm -q || exit 1`, tests/gate.sh:413).

items.criterion: The new/changed tests actually pass fresh and lint is clean
items.detail: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_substrate_hygiene.py -p no:cacheprovider -q` -> '22 passed in 0.36s', EXIT=0; `pytest tests/test_auger.py -k "teardown or leak or live_service or preflight or audit or fixture"` -> '18 passed, 319 deselected in 0.85s', EXIT=0; `ruff check tests/conftest.py tests/test_substrate_hygiene.py scripts/gate_timeout_report.py scripts/auger_ns_census.py` -> 'All checks passed!', EXIT=0.
